name: cat_push_key
desc: keep the same little black witch cat, same face with eyes shut tight as thin lines, mouth very slightly open, one small tear, same hat, cape, colors and size. Its legs and feet stay exactly where they are. It desperately pushes something away to the left: both arms stretched out hard toward the left with paws pressed flat outward, shoulders and upper body leaning to the left into the push, head turned slightly away to the right. Subtle cute face, not exaggerated.
